info.title: API.SH: InfoJobs
info.description: The InfoJobs API from API.SH: public InfoJobs data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
One job ad on InfoJobs: full description (text and HTML), company with logo and rating, city and province, remote work, salary, contract type, workday and duration, category and subcategory, industry, level, department, staff in charge, vacancies, number of applicants, minimum education and experience, minimum and desired requirements, languages, skills, benefits, published date and similar jobs. `latest=true` with search parameters returns the newest matching ad. Removed ads answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/infojobs-job

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Job id (`id` in search results, e.g. `e1c8fc2c8d4962b7aa6cdec5d60cfb`) or the infojobs.net ad link (…/of-i<id>).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: the first ad of a search with the other parameters (`q`, `province`, …) instead of an `id`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: With `latest=true`: keywords.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: With `latest=true`: `newest` for the latest ad.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Jobs on InfoJobs (infojobs.net, Spain's largest job board) for a keyword, with every filter of the site's search: provinces (names or ids, several comma separated), city, category and subcategory, remote work, education, workday, contract type, country, jobs abroad only, posting age and sort. `facets` lists each filter's values with ids and counts. Each job: `id`, `title`, `url`, `company`, `company_url`, `company_logo`, `city`, `contract`, `workday`, `remote`, `salary` (when shown), `description`, `published_at` and `raw`; plus related searches and companies. About 20 jobs a page; `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/infojobs-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords, e.g. `python`, `enfermera`. Leave empty for all jobs.

parameters.name: province
parameters.description: Spanish provinces, comma separated, e.g. `madrid`, `barcelona,valencia` (or ids from `facets.province`).

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: A city as listed in `facets.city`, e.g. `Madrid`.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category ids from `facets.category` (e.g. `150` = IT and telecoms), comma separated.

parameters.name: subcategory
parameters.description: Subcategory ids, comma separated.

parameters.name: remote
parameters.description: Remote work ids from `facets.remote`: `1` on-site, `2` remote only, `3` hybrid.

parameters.name: education
parameters.description: Minimum education ids from `facets.education`, comma separated.

parameters.name: workday
parameters.description: Workday ids from `facets.workday` (`1` full time …), comma separated.

parameters.name: contract
parameters.description: Contract type ids from `facets.contract` (`1` permanent, `8` fixed term …), comma separated.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country ids from `facets.country` (`17` = Spain), comma separated.

parameters.name: only_abroad
parameters.description: `true`: only jobs outside Spain.

parameters.name: posted_within_days
parameters.description: Posted within this many days.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
